frequency_question: What proportion of major economic trade negotiations that reach the advanced text-finalization stage successfully sign within a 28-month window?
membership_rule: Includes formal negotiations between major global economies designated as comprehensive free trade agreements or economic partnership agreements that reached advanced stages; excludes minor partial-scope or single-sector agreements.
coverage_note: 8 named modern comprehensive trade agreements between major market blocks; believed representative of contemporary trade pact velocities.
known_gaps: Does not fully account for idiosyncratic domestic political blocks that stall late-stage signatures indefinitely.
skeleton: Comprehensive trade agreements reaching final text stages grouped by completion velocity cohorts.
multiplier: 7 hits out of 8 comparable advanced-stage negotiations
validity_reason: Trade negotiation architecture, legal scrubbing processes, and political ratification friction evolve slowly over multi-year cycles.
